Richard "shox" Papillon (born May 27, 1992) is a French professional Counter-Strike 2 player and former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, Counter-Strike: Source and Counter-Strike player. He is one of the most famous Counter-Strike players, having played for top teams throughout his career such as VeryGames, Epsilon, EnVyUs, G2 Esports, Team Vitality, and Team Liquid.

Trivia

[edit]

Personal

[edit]
  • He got his name from the Nike Shox shoes, the sneakers he wore at the time of when he was thinking of choosing his name.
  • He was the subject of VaKarM's documentary film L'histoire d'une Légende (Journey of a Legend in English). It featured his former in-game leader Sebastién "KRL" Peréz, longtime teammate Edouard "SmithZz" Dubourdeaux, and father Patrick.
    • Considers KRL as the best player he's been under the leadership of. [3] He also considers KRL as his mentor throughout his career.
  • Has a player profile of his backstory from the FACEIT London Major 2018. [4]
  • He is the first ever player to win an HLTV MVP from the losing side, doing so at the DreamHack Valencia 2014.

Awards

[edit]
  • Was ranked the 3rd best player of 2013 by HLTV. [5]
  • Was ranked the 8th best player of 2014 by HLTV. [6]
  • Was ranked the 13th best player of 2015 by HLTV. [7]
  • Was ranked the 6th best player of 2016 by HLTV. [8]
  • Was ranked the 4th best player of 2016 by Thorin. [9]

MVPs

[edit]
  • Was named the HLTV MVP of 4 tournaments:
    • StarLadder StarSeries VII. [10]
    • DreamHack 2014 Invitational I. [11]
    • DreamHack Valencia 2014. [12]
    • Gfinity Masters Summer 1. [13]
